current_evidence: The council's 'What to submit with your planning application' local validation list page still links Full-Outline-Planning.docx as the 'Full Planning and Outline Application validation checklist' alongside six other checklists (Householder/Advertisement/Cert of Lawfulness/Larger home extension/Telecoms marked V5 Sept 2020) and 48 requirement pages; neither the page nor planning.data.gov.uk (start date 2024-01-01) gives an adoption date, so the list is effectively undated.

issues.detail: Heritage Impact Statement is not captured as a requirement under Householder or Full planning. Grokbot only has a 'Schedule of works (listed building)' row whose trigger is a sentence lifted from inside the Heritage Impact Statement guidance. Trigger: where the development affects locally or statutorily listed buildings (incl. setting), is in or affects the setting of a conservation area, or disturbs ground within an Area of Archaeological Potential.
issues.evidence: Householder checklist (Sept 2020): 'Heritage Impact Statement ... Required where the development affects locally or statutorily listed buildings (including their setting); where the development is in, or affects the setting of, a conservation area; where the development involves the disturbance of ground within an Area of Archaeological Potential.' Also a separate 'Heritage Impact Statement' requirement page on the local list.

issues.detail: 'Tall buildings / Wind microclimate assessment' has the trigger 'lighting and tall buildings.', a fragment of the Lighting Assessment text. The actual Wind Impact Assessment trigger is buildings of 10 storeys or more, or free-standing buildings that significantly exceed prevailing heights.
issues.evidence: Wind Impact Assessment page: 'Required for development of a building of 10 storeys or more ... any free standing buildings that significantly exceed the prevailing building heights in the immediate area.'

issues.detail: Digital 3D Modelling is missing. Trigger: major development, and applications with a significant townscape impact for medium to large-scale projects. Grokbot only captured 'CGI Visualisations' (mapped to Photographs/Photomontages).
issues.evidence: Digital 3D Modelling page: 'Digital 3D Modelling will be required for major development ... applications considered to have a significant impact on the townscape for medium to large scale projects.'

issues.detail: Several requirements on the council's local validation list index have no Grokbot row: Travel Plan, Transport Assessment (as distinct from Transport Statement), Parameter Plans and Development Specification (Outline only has Design Codes and Energy), Equalisation Statement, Statement of Reasons, Supporting Evidence for Existing Uses, Statement for telecommunication prior approval, Works to Trees in a Conservation Area and Works to Trees Subject to a TPO. Their triggers were not verified within the budget because the Full/Outline .docx could not be read by the fetch tool.
issues.evidence: Local validation list page sidebar lists 48 requirement pages, including 'Travel Plan', 'Parameter Plans', 'Development Specification', 'Equalisation Statement', 'Statement of Reasons', 'Supporting Evidence for Existing Uses', 'Works to Trees Subject to a TPO'.

issues.detail: Grokbot's link is only the Full/Outline checklist. The local list is a web page with 7 type-specific checklists. Grokbot never read the Certificate of Lawfulness, TPO/TCA (tree works), Larger home extension or Telecoms prior notification checklists, yet it marks 'Lawful development cert' and 'Works to trees' as having 'No specific local requirements identified'.
issues.evidence: Page links 'Certificate of Lawfulness validation checklist' (Cert-of-Lawfulness-V5-Sept-2020.pdf), 'TPO and TCA (Tree works) validation checklist' (Tree-Protection-Order-TCA.pdf), 'Larger home extension validation checklist', 'Prior notification Telecommunications checklist'.
issues.grok_comment: The core point stands: LDC and Works to trees are recorded as '(none)'. But the checklists were downloaded, with Certificate of Lawfulness, Works to Trees, Larger Home Extension and Telecoms copies in raw/ (f4bb2bde6d, 45237fef22, a2dc063c6a, 25e395f260), so this is a use or mapping failure, not checklists going unread.
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. The checklists were downloaded but not mapped; LDC and tree works are still (none).

issues.detail: List date is blank ('Undated'). The householder, advertisement and other checklists state September 2020 (V5). The Full/Outline docx was revised after mandatory BNG started (Feb 2024), because it contains BNG requirements. The workbook should record Sept 2020 for the type checklists and note that the Full/Outline list has an undated post-2024 revision. The council page itself gives no adoption date.
issues.evidence: Householder checklist text: 'Householder Planning Application Checklist' dated September 2020; file names '...-V5-Sept-2020.pdf'; planning.data.gov.uk local-area-requirements start date 2024-01-01.
issues.grok_comment: The blank List_date is correctly flagged. But the Full/Outline docx is not undated: its raw copy is headed "Full & Outline Planning Applications Checklist March 2025".
issues.claude_response: Kept, with a correction. The list date is still blank. The Full/Outline checklist says March 2025 and should be recorded.

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are fragments or belong to a different item. 'Transport Assessment / Transport Statement' = 'support of Transport Statements, depending on the parking stress in the area.'. 'Environmental Statement (EIA)' = 'within an EIA (if an EIA is required).'. 'Cycle parking details' carries the Drainage/SuDS trigger 'Required for all major planning applications'. 'Planning Obligations' starts with 'Landscape Institute'. 'Waste / Refuse' = 'developments require a waste management strategy...'. 'Street scene elevations' = 'within the street scene.'. 'Housing mix / dwelling standards' is cut off mid-word ('have be').
issues.evidence: app_type_rows Full planning / Householder trigger_excerpt values as quoted; requirement pages exist separately for Transport Assessment, Transport Statement, Travel Plan, Environmental Impact Assessment.

issues.detail: Householder triggers are truncated or misleading. The Tree Survey trigger omits 'Also where the application would affect other sizeable trees that are not covered by a TPO or in a Conservation Area'. The CIL form trigger is a fragment and omits that the form is needed for all applications except advertisement consent and details submissions. 'Block plan / Site plan' cites the Advertisement Regulations 2007 for householder applications.
issues.evidence: Householder checklist: CIL form 'All applications, with the exceptions of Advertisement consent and Submission of details pursuant to planning permission'; Tree Survey '...Also where the application would affect other sizeable trees that are not covered by a TPO or in a Conservation Area.'

issues.detail: Grokbot assigned application types by keyword. Lighting Assessment and Townscape and Visual Impact Assessment appear only under Listed building consent because their text mentions 'listed building', though they are planning-application requirements (publicly accessible or lit development, tall buildings, conservation areas). 'Planning Statement' is placed under 'Change of use - prior approval' because the text says 'major change of use applications', which are planning applications, not prior approvals. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' appears under Advertisement consent. Around 17 Full planning rows are marked 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. Several of these (Daylight/Sunlight 'on all applications', FRA 'all applications in Flood Zone 2 or 3', Foul Sewage, Noise) also apply to outline and other types, which Grokbot left out.
issues.evidence: Lighting Assessment: 'Required for all applications where the proposal involves the provision of publicly accessible developments, in the vicinity of residential property, a listed building or a conservation area...'; Daylight/Sunlight: 'Required on all applications where...'

issues.detail: 'Highways / access details (visibility splays)' and 'Parking provision / Parking plan' are the same source item (Parking and Access Details) with identical triggers. tab_items repeats the linear scale bar rule three times ('must', 'should', 'graphic ... must').
issues.evidence: Both rows: 'Parking and Access Details (Parking Provision) Required for all applications where parking provision is proposed as part of the development.'

issues.detail: tab_item '- Regulation 9 of The Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisements) (England) Regulations 2007 Site Plan A site plan to a stated metric scale, showing:' is a heading fragment, not a requirement. The Advertisement consent row 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' quotes the statutory definition of an advertisement rather than a trigger.
issues.evidence: Trigger excerpt: 'representation, whether illuminated or not, in the nature of, and employed wholly or partly for the purposes of, advertisement, announcement or direction...'

issues.detail: Householder 'Biodiversity Checklist / Questionnaire' is mislabelled. The source item is a 'Biodiversity Survey and Report' that is needed if the proposal is likely to affect wildlife and biodiversity, not a checklist or questionnaire.
issues.evidence: Householder checklist: 'Biodiversity Survey and Report. Required if proposal is likely to have an impact on wildlife and biodiversity.'

summary: Grokbot's link is the council's live Full/Outline checklist, but the local list is a web page with 7 checklists and 48 requirement pages, and Grokbot left the date blank (the type checklists are dated Sept 2020 V5). Extraction misses key items such as the Heritage Impact Statement, Wind Impact Assessment, Digital 3D Modelling, Travel Plan and the LDC/tree-works checklists, and has many fragmentary triggers. The Full/Outline .docx itself could not be parsed by the fetch tool, so it was checked against the council's requirement pages and the Householder PDF.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
